title: data set: economics data — effort signals, tier and effort defaults, mutation floor, token budgets, calibration bands, presets
description: Round 6 of #598, items 11-14: the effort-scaling signal catalog (three up-signals, three down-signals, each with its computable-from source per the contract — tracker, manifests, git history, no new capture) with initial tier-and-effort defaults and the per-auth-mode attribution grain declared; the mutation floor the thorough preset declares; per-artifact-class token budgets for the CI gate; initial calibration bands seeded from this respec's own observed rounds and marked as seeds pending actuals; and the three preset contents. The heaviest operator-owned set in the package — every number is a proposal until adoption. Owner: data-engineer. Validator: ai-engineer (the advisory queries and the ledger dimensions are that domain's owned surface).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: OPERATOR ADOPTION 2026-07-20, all four blocks as proposed: the six effort signals with computation sources and the initial tier/effort defaults (terminal verify rounds at high); the 80 percent mutation kill-ratio floor on changed code; the per-class token budgets (5000/3000/2500/2000/1500) and the seeded calibration bands with the code-review band honestly unseeded; and the three presets with thorough as this project's declaration. Data Engineer pass under the session's loaded lens: no new findings — pair rule followed, band provenance required by schema, signal sources pinned to existing capture (no new capture introduced), preset cardinality pinned. AI Engineer validator note for the spec-review round: the advisory loop's decision routing (absorbable advisories execute, provisioning reaches the operator with the math) is conduct the session skill carries — this data set only supplies the signals and defaults it computes from.
